items.question: How does personalization work?
items.answer: You choose a product, enter your child's details, upload their photo, and choose their favorite world or character. We design the product based on your choices.

items.question: What photo should I upload?
items.answer: A clear, recent photo of your child's face, with good lighting where possible.

items.question: Can I choose a character or theme?
items.answer: Yes — each product has its own customization options, and additional requests may be available.

items.question: How long does production take?
items.answer: Usually 2-5 days to design and prepare the product for print. This is production time only, not delivery time.

items.question: How is delivery handled?
items.answer: We reach out after your order to coordinate shipping and delivery details based on your location.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: You can pay Cash on Delivery or via Whish Money — details are confirmed with you directly.

items.question: Will my child's photo be kept?
items.answer: We use the photo only to prepare your order, and it is deleted after the order is completed, per our privacy policy.

items.question: Can I request changes before printing?
items.answer: Yes — we review the design with you over WhatsApp before final printing.
